== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Deploy changes 2 to 3. Immunity to game-text cancellation becomes conditional on being at opponent's Senate. The battle clause drops ‘opponent's’ before the qualifying leader. The out-of-play action and forfeit 5 agree. The separately captured official PC 2007 full face has the revised text and deploy 3.
